title: The Ship To Ship Phenomenon
summary: Why is the volume of ship-to-ship transfers growing? Global crude oil and refined product trade flows have reshuffled after the Russian attack on Ukraine. Sanctions have closed off certain markets, such as Europe and forced a rethink about how to best serve more distant new markets (like India and China).
